data.body: Fix pushed as Gerrit change 2053: added a note to docs/llm-framework.md's structured-retry/accounting section stating that a fallback chain's capability record is the conservative intersection over its candidates (authority: runner_support._intersect_capabilities, src/rebar/llm/runner_support.py:44-57), that disagreeing prompt-cache styles collapse to 'none' for the whole chain, and that a chain-backed op therefore legitimately reports 0/0 cache read/write while the same model alone caches normally; cross-referenced the rebar.toml fallback note. Documentation only. Note: the parallel docs-infrastructure audit session (epic 23e8) may relocate this content later; this change is content-accuracy only, no restructuring.
